verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's search filters (GPU type, RAM, CPU, bandwidth) and 'Secure Cloud' verified-datacenter labels imply some geographic/facility transparency, but there is no documented region/residency selection filter for where compute or data physically resides. A community report describes a host masquerading as US-based when actually located in China, directly contradicting the platform's location-verification claims. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection filter in search, documented data-residency guarantees, first-party rebuttal to the masquerading report.
